content.short: 0x is an open-source protocol and developer infrastructure for building decentralized exchanges and on-chain trading applications with best-price execution.
content.description: 0x Protocol, founded in 2017 by Will Warren and Amir Bandeali, is a foundational DeFi infrastructure layer providing APIs and smart contracts that enable developers to build DEX aggregators, NFT marketplaces, and financial applications. The 0x API aggregates liquidity from hundreds of sources to provide best-price execution for any token swap, and is used by leading wallets and DeFi products including MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, and Matcha. 0x is officially supported by Mantle Network and powers trading infrastructure across the ecosystem.
content.meta: 0x provides developer infrastructure for building DEX and trading applications with best-price execution on Mantle. Discover 0x on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
